# elysium

> Source of Asphodel (`@saluca/asphodel` 0.3.0): a TypeScript library for local-first AI agent memory with integer ids, a topic-word index, full-text search and optional hybrid vector search, on SQLite or Postgres. FSL-1.1-ALv2.

Facts agents often get wrong: the repository is named elysium but the package inside is `@saluca/asphodel`. It is not on npm (the name was removed on 2026-09-16, and the 0.4.0 that was once published came from a different repository); build from source. It is a library, not a server or CLI. `maxMemoriesPerTopic` is an adapter option, not an `Asphodel` option. Without a hybrid provider there is no deduplication, and `PostgresAdapter` has no vector search. CommonJS output in dist/, Node.js 18 or later, native better-sqlite3 binding required.

## Complete public surface

If a name is not listed here, it is not exported. Everything comes from src/index.ts:

- `Asphodel(adapter, config?)`: `init()`, `remember(content, { topics?, skipDedup? })`, `recall(topic, { limit? })`, `search(query, { limit? })`, `hybridSearch(query, { limit?, decay?, hyde?, rerank? })`, `forget(id)`, `list(limit?, offset?)`, `close()`. Config: `maxTopicsPerMemory`, `extractTopics`, `hybrid`
- `SQLiteAdapter(path | { dbPath?, maxMemoriesPerTopic?, vectorDims? })`, env `ASPHODEL_DB` (default ~/.asphodel/memory.db)
- `PostgresAdapter(connectionString?, maxMemoriesPerTopic = 10)`, env `ASPHODEL_DATABASE_URL`; needs the `pg` peer
- `LocalHybridProvider(options)`: `init()`, `embed()`, `generate()`, `rerank()`, `close()`; needs the `node-llama-cpp` peer and your GGUF files
- `AsphodelStore(asphodel)`: `store()`, `recall()`, `forget()`, `stats()` with string ids (untested here)
- Types: `Memory`, `ScoredMemory`, `Adapter`, `HybridProvider`, `AsphodelConfig`, `RememberOptions`, `RecallOptions`, `SearchOptions`, `HybridSearchOptions`
- npm scripts: `build`, `test`, `clean`, `check:meta`. Example: `node examples/quickstart.mjs`

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/README.md): how it works (diagrams), install, quickstart, API, schema, correction notes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/AGENTS.md): orientation, the numbers to trust with their sources, build and test commands

## In depth

- [src/store.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/store.ts): the Asphodel API (remember, recall, search, hybridSearch, forget, list)
- [src/types.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/types.ts): Adapter, HybridProvider and option types
- [src/adapters/sqlite.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/adapters/sqlite.ts): SQLite schema, FTS5 search, sqlite-vec vectors
- [src/adapters/postgres.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/adapters/postgres.ts): Postgres adapter
- [src/hybrid/local.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/hybrid/local.ts): LocalHybridProvider (node-llama-cpp embeddings, HyDE, rerank)

## Build on it or verify it

- [examples/quickstart.mjs](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/examples/quickstart.mjs): runnable quickstart against the local build
- [tests/asphodel.test.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/tests/asphodel.test.ts): the 23 SQLite tests
